name: Equilateral Glass Prism
semanticDescription: Equilateral 60° optical crown glass dispersion prism (side 65mm, height 75mm, n = 1.52) mounted on a turned brass spectrometer turntable, demonstrating Newton's dispersion of white light into the 7 spectral rainbow colors VIBGYOR (CBSE Class 10 Ch 11).
simplifications: Spectral fan discretely traces the 7 canonical rainbow wavelengths (ROYGBIV) onto observation screen.

materials.look: Turned brass spectrometer turntable with graduated degree circle
Collimated incident white light pencil beam
Diffusion matte white observation projection screen
